The Defective Detective — Album 2: Serah Investigates

Spray and Pray

"Spray and pray Take the shot anyway"

[Verse] Red was written before my name Before I learned the rules of the game Old family stories, half remembered Goblins fought when the world got centered

They said order came and we said no Said we wouldn’t stand where they told us to go How long ago? Hell if I know Long enough that the color still shows

[Pre-Chorus] Kitsune high Elves beside Some of us started at the bottom line

So I learned early If I wanted out

I had to climb

[Chorus] Spray and pray Take the shot anyway Point the lens at what they bury Hope the truth survives the day

Spray and pray Work until your hands give way If the world already judged you Make it choke on what you frame

[Verse] Stayed up late with borrowed books Learned the angles, learned the hooks Photography Journalism Every class another rung

Skipped some meals to pay the fees Worked through nights on shaking knees Every grade a little higher Every “good job” fed the fire

Red to Orange Orange to Yellow Copper finally by my name

Whole damn family still back home

And I was supposed to change the game

[Pre-Chorus] Do more Stay late Never give them room to say

“See? She’s just another goblin.”

So I worked twice hard For half the grace

[Chorus] Spray and pray Take the shot anyway Point the lens at what they bury Hope the truth survives the day

Spray and pray Work until your hands give way If the world already judged you Make it choke on what you frame

[Bridge] Mama needs rent Brother needs shoes Someone needs medicine Someone needs food

So every paycheck Part went home

Copper on paper Red in the phone

“Kamira, we’re proud.”

Yeah

That’s the part that hurts

Because now there’s no paycheck coming And pride doesn’t cover groceries first

[Break] I could’ve stayed quiet

Could’ve cropped the frame

Could’ve called corruption Something with a safer name

Could’ve smiled at the editor Kept my desk Kept my pay

…

No

[Pre-Chorus] I saw what I saw And somebody had to say

If seeing too much costs everything

Then fine

Make me pay

[Chorus] Spray and pray Take the shot anyway Every secret hates a camera Every liar hates the day

Spray and pray Let the shutter disobey If integrity means losing Then I’ll lose the honest way

[Final Chorus] Spray and pray I climbed too far to look away Red behind me Copper under me And family depending on my pay

Spray and pray Maybe truth won’t feed them today But what kind of future did I build If I learned to hide what I became?

Spray and pray Camera up No safe escape

I owe my family everything

But I owe myself my name

[Outro] No newsroom No salary

Still send what I can

Still got the camera

Still got the files

Still got the shot

[Spoken] [clean voice only]

“They needed the money.”

…

“I needed the truth.”
